about.title: Lake Elsinore Wrongful Death Claims
about.longDescription: Riverside County recorded 7 traffic deaths in the most recent final year, alongside hundreds of injury collisions across corridors like I-15, Lakeshore Drive, and Riverside Drive. When one of those crashes takes a life, the family left behind faces grief and a wall of practical questions—medical bills, funeral costs, lost income, and unanswered questions about what happened. A wrongful death claim in California is a separate civil action from any criminal case, and it exists to help surviving spouses, domestic partners, children, or in some cases other dependents recover certain losses. We handle wrongful death claims and can review your crash, explain standing and deadlines, and help you decide next steps. There's no obligation to move forward, and no fee unless we recover something for your family.

whyChoose.title: Why Lake Elsinore Families Choose Us

items.title: Standing Rules Can Be Confusing
items.desc: California limits who may bring a wrongful death claim, generally starting with a spouse, domestic partner, or children before other dependents or heirs. We can clarify who in your family qualifies to file.

items.title: The Clock Starts Running Fast
items.desc: Most wrongful death claims must be filed within two years of the date of death, and that window shortens significantly if a government entity was involved, such as a public road issue. Getting in touch with us early helps protect that deadline.

items.title: Recoverable Losses Go Beyond Bills
items.desc: California law allows families to seek compensation for funeral costs and lost financial support, but also for the loss of a loved one's companionship and guidance. We can help value both the tangible and intangible losses.

items.question: Who is allowed to file a wrongful death claim in California?
items.answer: Typically a surviving spouse, domestic partner, or children have the first right to file. If none exist, other dependents or heirs may be able to bring the claim. We can review your family's specific situation to confirm standing.

items.question: Is a wrongful death claim the same as a criminal case?
items.answer: No. A wrongful death claim is a separate civil action focused on compensation for the family, while any criminal charges against a driver are handled independently by prosecutors. Both can move forward at the same time without affecting each other's outcome.

items.question: Does it matter that the crash happened on a road like Railroad Canyon Road or Lakeshore Drive?
items.answer: The specific road doesn't change the legal standing or filing deadline, but it can matter for gathering evidence like traffic reports, signal timing, or witness accounts. Corridors around Lake Elsinore with higher recorded collision counts sometimes have more available public data, which we can review.

items.question: What do you charge for a wrongful death case review?
items.answer: Nothing. Our case reviews are free, and we work on contingency, meaning there's no fee unless we recover money for your family. You're never obligated to move forward after speaking with us.
